title: MCP stage_add_shape only accepts solid fill — gradient/bitmap fills unreachable
description: The stage_add_shape MCP tool schema accepts fill as a single #RRGGBB string, and buildFill() in packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts (line 252) hardcodes type:'solid'. The core model (engine/types.ts Fill = SolidFill | LinearGradientFill | RadialGradientFill | BitmapFill), SWF compiler, and renderer all fully support gradients. An agent wanting a gradient-filled shape must use jsfl_run with hand-coded JSFL. Fix: extend the stage_add_shape schema with an optional gradient sub-object { type: 'linear'|'radial', stops: [{color, alpha, ratio}], angle? } and update buildFill in registry.ts to parse it into a LinearGradientFill or RadialGradientFill model object.
